text: A virtual environment keeps its own site‑packages directory separate from the system‑wide one, so only packages installed inside the environment are on its import path [1]. When the environment is active, Python looks for modules in `my_env/lib/pythonX.Y/site‑packages` rather than the global location [2]. Because `numpy` was never installed into that isolated directory, the import machinery cannot find it and raises `ModuleNotFoundError`. Thus the script will not import `numpy` successfully.
